title: 给植物浇水 II
summary: Alice 从左、Bob 从右同时给植物浇水，各自水不足当前植物需求时补满，求总补水次数；相遇时水更多者浇。
insight: 双指针向中间模拟，两人各在浇当前植物前检查余水，不足则补水并计数。若最后剩同一株，用两人较大余水判断是否还需一次补水。
pitfalls: 初始水壶已装满不计补水
水量相等时任选不影响是否补水

solutions.title: 双端剩余水模拟
solutions.idea: 同步推进左右指针并处理可能的中间植物。
steps: left<right 时分别不足则补满计数，再扣需求并推进
left==right 且 max(alice,bob)<plants[left] 时再计一次，返回

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumRefill(int[] plants,int capacityA,int capacityB){int left=0,right=plants.length-1,alice=capacityA,bob=capacityB,answer=0;while(left<right){if(alice<plants[left]){answer++;alice=capacityA;}alice-=plants[left++];if(bob<plants[right]){answer++;bob=capacityB;}bob-=plants[right--];}if(left==right&&Math.max(alice,bob)<plants[left])answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumRefill(plants:IntArray,capacityA:Int,capacityB:Int):Int{var left=0;var right=plants.lastIndex;var alice=capacityA;var bob=capacityB;var answer=0;while(left<right){if(alice<plants[left]){answer++;alice=capacityA};alice-=plants[left++];if(bob<plants[right]){answer++;bob=capacityB};bob-=plants[right--]};if(left==right&&maxOf(alice,bob)<plants[left])answer++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minimumRefill(vector<int>& plants,int capacityA,int capacityB){int left=0,right=plants.size()-1,alice=capacityA,bob=capacityB,answer=0;while(left<right){if(alice<plants[left]){++answer;alice=capacityA;}alice-=plants[left++];if(bob<plants[right]){++answer;bob=capacityB;}bob-=plants[right--];}if(left==right&&max(alice,bob)<plants[left])++answer;return answer;} };
